findings.evidence: description names codex exec and resume but no intent keywords such as second opinion, GPT or delegating to another agent
findings.fix: Run or resume OpenAI Codex CLI tasks with `codex exec` or `codex exec resume`, choosing the sandbox (read-only analysis, user-authorized workspace edits, network) and reporting model, effort and whether edits occurred. Use when asked to invoke Codex or a GPT coding agent for review, debugging, refactoring, automated edits, a second opinion, or to continue an existing Codex session, even if the user only says 'ask codex' or 'have GPT look at this'. Not for installing the CLI, configuring credentials, conceptual explanations, summarizing prior output without invocation, or other vendors' CLIs.
